resources.string: Import desktop settings
Import settings from your computer using a Televim link, QR code, or a local file. This import does not use the internet or a local network. Telegram can still connect normally.
Televim settings link
Export password (not your Telegram password)
Scan settings QR
Preview import
Apply settings and retain package

For a file, open your device storage in the system Files app. For JSON, choose Open with → Televim. For an encrypted .tgv file, choose Open with or Share → Televim. Only physical local storage from the system provider is accepted. Cloud files, virtual files, and web links are rejected. Encrypted files can be at most 8 MiB; JSON can be at most 2 MiB.
Local settings file
A local file is selected. Enter its export password if encrypted, then preview. A JSON settings file does not need a password.
Checking the package locally…
Could not inspect this package. Check its format, size, export password, and local file source. No settings were applied.
This is not a supported Televim settings QR. Nothing was opened or imported.
Import cancelled. Settings were not changed.
Temporary import data could not be removed. Import is disabled until you restart Televim.
QR read locally. Enter the separate export password, then preview the settings.
These supported preferences apply to the whole app, across all accounts. Applying replaces the values shown below.
Large emoji

Retained inactive: %1$d unsupported modules, %2$d resources, %3$d account profiles. Package size: %4$d bytes.

Account profiles and unsupported desktop features are preserved inside the package but are not activated or merged with Android data. No account is signed in, no automation starts, and no messages are sent. Account identity includes the Telegram environment and user ID.
This package contains no supported preferences to apply.
Retain package without applying preferences
Package retained privately on this device. No preferences were applied.
This JSON file is not encrypted. Only the displayed allowlisted preferences are accepted.
Settings applied. The package is retained privately on this device; unsupported features remain inactive.
This exact package was already imported. Nothing was changed.
Settings changed after this preview. Preview again before applying.
The write result could not be confirmed. Import is disabled until you restart Televim. No successful import is being reported.
Point the camera at the settings QR on your computer. Decoding runs on this device. Other QR links are not opened.
The camera is unavailable or permission was denied. Go back and paste a settings link or open a local file instead.
